notes: The candidate URL (oversight.govsignals.ai) did not resolve (ENOTFOUND). I used search-result snippets and two mirror pages that did load: SweetSpot and HigherGov. NIH 75N92025R00033 is a non-competitive presolicitation (posted 4 Jun 2025, responses due 18 Jun 2025). NHLBI intends to modify its existing sole-source contract with Illumina for NIH Intramural Sequencing Center (NISC) reagents. The period of performance is extended from 3 Sep 2020 to 2 Mar 2026. The page gives no value, no line items, no discount terms and no predecessor number. The only price term is that the price is firm for 60 days, plus prompt-payment terms. A separate successor IDV, 75N98026D00035, was awarded in May 2026 (EO 14398, NHGRI-funded, sole source, 1 bid). It has a $90M ceiling, $5.4M obligated so far (6%), and an ordering period of 21 May 2026 to 21 May 2031. The HigherGov page shows pricing as 'Order Dependent' and lists no kit mix, discount or list/GSA reference. Both records are procurement metadata with no SKU or discount data. This is probably the NIH vehicle already known as F765, though I could not confirm that. The thesis effect is tiny: $5.4M obligated in about 5 months is far below Illumina's scale. It shows only that NIH intramural demand is sole-sourced, with no competitive pressure visible.
how_to_mine: Look up USAspending.gov award 75N98026D00035 for modification and order history. Search the 'EO 14398' notice and related opportunity 75N92026R00019 on SAM.gov for a J&A or sole-source justification. Those documents may state kit SKUs, a discount off list/GSA, or the prior-contract price. Also check the FOIA reading room or the NIH J&A postings. Expect low odds of line-item pricing.

items.detail: NIH awarded IDV 75N98026D00035 to Illumina in May 2026 with 1 bid received. It has a $90M ceiling over a 5-year ordering period (to 21 May 2031) and $5.4M obligated so far (6%). The prior NISC contract was extended through 2 Mar 2026 by non-competitive modification. No discount terms or kit mix are published.
items.why_new: The 75N98026D00035 ceiling, term and sole-source status were not in the known list, though this is probably the same vehicle as F765.
